policies.title: Lebanese ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism route accepts citizens of all countries and sends the tourism visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Apply online using a valid Lebanese ordinary biometric passport with the F5A tourism supporting documents and payment; the visitor route is single entry for up to 30 days.
The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current document does not identify a Lebanese ordinary-passport waiver; the all-country eVisa route is retained with medium confidence.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Lebanese ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and receive the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Lebanese ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the same valid Lebanese ordinary biometric passport for application and travel; non-regular travel documents are not accepted.
Apply through the authenticated eVisa service and receive the eVisa by email in PDF form before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, Palestinian travel-document, special-document, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the Lebanese ordinary passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa for final immigration processing and admission.
